about: S-tasks - Feladatok (/tasks, design round B frame lifeos/tasks-1), the task sheet (lifeos/task-form) and the capture sheet (lifeos/capture), plus the undrawn tabs and states. GET /tasks is not in the freeze (the dev backend has no migration 032): every state answers it with a contract body in the exact TasksResponse shape, checked by fixture-schema-check.mjs, so a verdict reaches matched-fixture at best until the integrator records it (then the bodies become edit lists). The clock is Monday 19 October 2026 14:00 (the frames' seed day). Nothing is written live: no write fires in any state.
